name: What is a home trade-in program?

mainEntity.name: What is a home trade-in program?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home trade-in program allows you to sell your current home and purchase a new one simultaneously. This can simplify the home-buying process by eliminating the need to coordinate two separate transactions or contingency clauses. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution helps manage both transactions, offering a streamlined experience for clients looking to move to a new property within Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County.
